scope: Installed or candidate binary in a real PTY; actual Engine/Job calls to authored localhost Responses. The 32 sidebar conversations are mechanical state/title fixtures, not completed model tasks. No remote model or personal credentials.

checks.name: current title and keyboard candidate styles combine on the same session
mixed titles expose distinct required attention words
current identity and browsed candidate remain different without color
session information shows its real status and persisted local update time
authored sidebar list remains a session list
leaving sidebar removes candidate highlight while preserving current identity without model work
session switch keeps answer target, caret and selection
all existing target drafts survive session switch and process restart
Tab completes a slash candidate without execution
slash Enter opens its selected action in one step
click input edits only the draft
action failure remains until correction, rather than expiring
final API step allows checking the actual connection before saving
API key does not enter terminal text or conversation
inactive empty parent draft has no second reversed caret behind the API form
separate history work leaves original question and its answer draft paused
completed Idle session keeps its core pause flag without offering empty resumption
reading at the top loads older persisted conversation
navigation and historical loading make no new model requests

frames.step: Real terminal: current session is also the keyboard candidate

Restart restores the actual targeted answer
Separate new requirement remains intact after returning from a question and restart
Slash Enter directly opens model editing; parent input stays separate
Clicking the visible composer permits editing without sending
A real local command error keeps its draft and readable cause
Failure remains visible after the old eight-second expiry window
Before saving: connection, model and endpoint remain visible beside a masked API key
